name: gitfolio
description: Your developer type, tech stack periods and a portfolio from your own git history, through the GitFolio CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Developer type, tech stack and portfolio from your git history
interface.longDescription: Reads what the GitFolio CLI collects on this computer and what aline.team works out from it: your developer type and five scores, how long you used each technology, and a Markdown portfolio to edit. Needs the GitFolio CLI installed and logged in.
defaultPrompt: Use GitFolio to explain my developer type and scores.
Use GitFolio to turn my git history into a portfolio for this job posting.
